Callout.Name: Possible Methamphetamine Lab
Callout.Message: Strong chemical smell from a rented property.
Callout.Advisory: No persons seen, landlord reporting through the letterbox.

Script.Line: I rent it out. I have never been inside it.
The smell is the drains. It has been the drains for a year.
Ask the tenants. Oh wait, you cannot, because they have gone.

Lines.Approach: Landlord says the smell has been there a week and nobody has been seen going in.
Lines.SignOff: Show me 10-8 when you are clear.
